name: bld2_pisano_fib_even_eq
statement: (n : ℕ) (h4 : 4 ≤ n) (h2 : 2 ∣ n) : p3_pisano (Nat.fib n) = 2 * n
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h4 : 4 ≤ n) (h2 : 2 ∣ n), p3_pisano (Nat.fib n) = 2 * n
informal: Uses Mathlib2.p3_prop2: the period k divides 2n; being a period forces fib n ∣ fib k, hence n ∣ k (gcd property of Fibonacci numbers, n ≥ 3), so k = n or k = 2n; k = n is impossible because fib (n+1) ≡ fib (n-1) mod fib n and 1 < fib (n-1) < fib n for n ≥ 4.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 4 ≤ n → 2 ∣ n → Mathlib2.p3_pisano (Nat.fib n) = 2 * n
